purpose: Prove the open Agent-neutral demand-driven human-Agent collaboration quality harness through goal-level natural-task dogfooding, dynamic capability discovery and lifecycle arbitration, an accepted methodology and open quality-conformance profile, and thin cross-host reference adapters that reuse sufficient external protocol, runtime, identity, audit, provenance, and evaluation layers.

increments.observedProblem: O5 requires the common Harness semantics to cross a distinct Agent host through a thin adapter, but the current tree contains only a Codex projection. Live observation found an already-installed and authenticated Claude Code 2.1.231 runtime whose native SessionStart lifecycle and session-scoped --plugin-dir exposure can reuse the existing stateless authority projection without a persistent installation, account change, or user-managed capability route.
increments.hypothesis: A Hook-only Claude Code projection that translates the host's native SessionStart input and plain-stdout context output into the same repository-owned authority projection will isolate all host differences behind a thin, stateless adapter and provide the minimum executable candidate needed before any separately authorized matched cross-host task.
increments.falsifier: The fixed Claude Code 2.1.231 plugin contract requires a persistent installation, Skill, MCP server, command, state store, copied portable core, user configuration, or new protocol; cannot represent startup, resume, clear, and compact without reading prompt or transcript content; cannot fail to a non-blocking no-op outside the Harness root or on runtime drift; cannot pass the host's strict manifest validator and offline semantic-parity tests without a model call; or creates conventional repository or consumer residue.
increments.stopCondition: Stop after one Claude Code Hook-only projection either passes the fixed host's strict plugin validation plus offline input, output, root, drift, and common-semantics parity checks with no user configuration or residue, or is rejected and removed; record zero O1-O5 progress, restore an empty ready graph, and leave live cross-host execution, model cost, equivalence tolerance, and human outcome judgment to a separately pre-registered and authorized O5 task.

deliverables: one inactive session-scoped Claude Code reference projection that reuses the common Harness authority semantics without persistent installation or consumer mutation
